{"text":"MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming devices, smart speakers and smart displays do not solve the computer connection needs reflected in my adapter and cable purchases.",
    "My tablet mount purchase was about attaching a device to a support; it does not mean I need a new tablet.",
    "The earbuds have some connection to my older headset purchase, but that alone gives me no reason to replace it or switch to wireless audio.",
    "Smart plugs and security cameras assume home automation needs that my purchases do not suggest."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat interest in computer accessories as interest in electronic devices generally.",
    "Several suggestions assume I want a collection of Alexa-compatible devices, although my history gives no indication of that interest."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases repeatedly address specific practical tasks: adding ports, connecting to networks, connecting a display and mounting a tablet.",
    "My most recent purchase was a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, which makes computer connectivity more relevant than entertainment or home automation.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart, so an older headset or tablet accessory is a weak reason to assume I need another related device now.",
    "I rarely interact unless something meets a concrete need; a broad connection to electronics is not enough to make me choose an item."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations interpreted my practical computer accessory purchases as broad interest in connected home and entertainment devices."
}"}
